sayings.ml: ഒരു ജാതി ഒരു മതം ഒരു ദൈവം മനുഷ്യന്
sayings.translit: oru jāti oru matam oru daivam manuṣyanu
sayings.en: One caste, one religion, one god for humankind.
sayings.sourceEn: The best known of his sayings, carved and quoted everywhere in Kerala.

sayings.en: Whatever the religion, it is enough that a person becomes good.
sayings.sourceEn: Widely attributed. Malayalam original to be added from a printed edition.

sayings.en: Ask not, say not, think not caste.
sayings.sourceEn: Widely attributed. Malayalam original to be added from a printed edition.

sayings.en: Strengthen through organisation, grow strong through education.
sayings.sourceEn: Widely attributed, often rendered as 'organise and be strong, educate and be free'. Original wording to be confirmed.

archives.titleEn: Narayana Guru Digital Research Resource Platform
archives.noteEn: A digitisation project led by IIT Bombay with the Sree Narayana Mandira Samity, Mumbai and others. Around 270,000 scanned pages, including the magazines Vivekodayam, Mitavadi, Sahodaran, Dharmam and Yuktivadi. Part of the collection is on JSTOR through South Asia Open Archives.
A government portal with sections on his life, philosophy and literary works, in English and Malayalam.
